title: "Alpha Guide"

Alpha is a small command line tool.

## Install

Run the zephyrine installer to set up Alpha on your machine.

## Usage

Invoke alpha from the shell.

### Flags

Pass the quokka flag to enable verbose mode, or the narwhal flag for quiet mode.
